sn5.6:1.5: bhikkhuni → bhikkhunī (bj) | rocesīti → rocesīti cālābhikkhunī (bj) | kinnu → kinnu kho tvaṁ (bj: syā) | rocesīti → SS. rocasīti. (pts note)
sn5.6:1.6: rocemīti → rocemi (pts) | Jātiṁ → SS. jāti. (pts note)
sn5.6:2.1: kiṁ nu → māro kinnu (bj) | nu → nu tvaṁ (pts) | tvaṁ → SS. omit tvaṁ. (pts note)
sn5.6:2.3: taṁ → tvaṁ (sya-all) | tam → SS. tvam. (pts note) | ādapayi → B. ādiyi. (pts note)
sn5.6:2.4: bhikkhunīti → bhikkhunīti cālābhikkhunī (bj) | roca → rocesi (pts) | māroca → rocesi (bj: sīmu) | roca → mā rocesi (cck: sī. pī.) | rocesi → SS. roca. (pts note)
sn5.6:3.2: phussati → passati (pts) | phussati → passati (bj: sīmu3, syā) | phussati → passati (cck: sī. pī.) | passati → B. phussati. (pts note)

sn5.6:5.2: arūpaṭṭhāyino → āruppaṭhāyino (bj); arūpabhāgino (sya-all) | arūpaṭṭhāyino nirodhaṁ → ārūppaṭṭhāyino nirodham (pts) | ārūppaṭṭhāyino → B. arūpaṭṭhāyino. See above, No. 4. (pts note)
